forecasts.question: Will Iran resume negotiations with the US before EOD 2026-06-16?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO (Day 155, 2026-08-01). Iran suspended talks June 1; Araghchi June 3 confirmed no formal negotiation process underway, only written messages exchanged; no held session occurred before EOD June 16. MOU signed June 17 — one day after the horizon. Trump assertions without Iranian or mediator confirmation applied ambiguity_rule. → NO.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-06-16, a publicly confirmed HELD negotiating session (direct or mediated via Oman/Qatar/Pakistan) occurs between named US and Iranian principals/envoys, OR an official Iranian statement (MFA/state media IRNA/Tasnim/Fars) rescinds the 2026-06-01 suspension. A held mediated session counts; mere rhetorical assertion that 'talks continue' or relay of written messages does NOT count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: TIER1: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official Iranian state-media; State Dept or Iran MFA statement also resolves.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Trump-only assertions without Iranian/mediator confirmation do NOT count; written-message exchanges that are not a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; one side asserting talks 'continue' without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will mine-countermeasure clearing operations actively commence in Hormuz before EOD 2026-07-10?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO (AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; Day 155, 2026-08-01). April 11 CENTCOM MCM operations (USS Pioneer MCM 9, USS Chief MCM 14) predate the June 10 to July 10 monitoring window — they cannot satisfy a 'commence between June 10 and July 10' criterion. UK-France multinational mission (July 4-6) was positioning/arrival, not confirmed in-Strait commencement. National Defense Magazine July 27 reported US still 'pondering how to carry out demining in contested waters' — direct evidence against confirmed commencement in window. Ambiguity_rule applied: 'Stated intent, vessel positioning, or planning without confirmed commencement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.' DA disputed, citing April 11 CENTCOM reporting and Operation Project Freedom May 4 — judge overrules: strict window interpretation requires a new commencement event within June 10 to July 10; April operations predate and do not constitute a fresh commencement inside the window. → NO.

forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-YES (retroactively dated ~2026-05-27; confirmed Day 155, 2026-08-01). Mid-May 2026: UTJ departure reduced coalition from 68 to 61 seats (i24 News, JPost). Late May 2026: coalition 'found itself without a functioning majority for the first time' (parliamentjournal.com, i24 News) — coalition dropped below 61. Ambiguity_rule explicitly covers this scenario: 'If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES.' Resolution_criteria condition 2 (election date earlier than Oct 27) = NO, as the Knesset set the election at exactly Oct 27 in the July 17 final reading (62-0 vote). However, the ambiguity_rule condition is satisfied by the confirmed late-May coalition drop below 61. Judge overrules Analyst (who carried ACTIVE at p=0.07): Analyst's reading that the July 17 dissolution was the relevant event was incorrect — the ambiguity_rule trigger point was ~late May. DA correctly identified this as a ~10-week hygiene error. Netanyahu continues as caretaker PM to Oct 27 election. → YES.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: TIER1: Knesset official record + Reuters/Haaretz/Times of Israel. Polling alone does not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO. Reviewed weekly only (Sundays); no intra-week deltas.

forecasts.question: Will Mojtaba Khamenei make a confirmed in-person public appearance inside Iran before EOD 2026-11-01?
forecasts.delta_reason: Initial estimate. Mojtaba Khamenei became Supreme Leader following his father Ali Khamenei's death (February 28 2026) and public confirmation March 8 2026. As of August 1, he has not made a confirmed in-person public appearance inside Iran in approximately 5 months — unprecedented for a sitting Supreme Leader. Washington Times assessment: likely in Russia. Al Jazeera and NPR assess him as 'more hardline than his father with ties to the most ideologically extremist clerics.' The security risk of appearing publicly inside Iran during active US strikes creates a strong deterrent against in-person appearances. Against this: the religious legitimacy function of the Supreme Leader requires eventual public presence; a 5-month absence is institutionally unsustainable and creates a vacuum that operationally visible IRGC commanders (Abdollahi, July 24) are filling — not a stable substitute. 0.43 reflects balanced uncertainty between the security deterrent and the structural legitimacy pressure. The 92-day horizon allows for the possibility that a ceasefire or operational pause creates conditions for appearance.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a confirmed in-person public appearance by Mojtaba Khamenei inside Iranian territory — defined as a physical event attended by identifiable witnesses, not a remote address, written statement, or audio recording — before EOD 2026-11-01.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: TIER1: Two independent TIER1 sources (Reuters/AP/Al Jazeera/BBC/NYT) OR one TIER1 + official IRNA/state media footage confirmed as current-date and Iranian location. Footage without confirmed date and location is AMBIGUOUS.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Written statements, audio messages, or undated/unlocated video do NOT count; appearance in Russia or outside Iranian territory does NOT count; if IRNA airs footage without confirmed location inside Iran, apply AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; archive footage recycled as current does NOT count.
